composition.serve_who: This sheet ("AFT COMPANION WAY", DWG GMMS 108'-118a) documents the J/BOX in the aft companionway that controls the pneumatic hatch/inflatable seal system (hatch open/closed valves, digital pressure switch, inflate/deflate valves, reed switch closed-signal) — this is the same pneumatic-hatch system named "AFT COMPANION WAY"/"SALOON COMPANION WAY" mapped to node 575-pneumatic-system. Two small tag-alike items ride on the same J/BOX wiring bundle but are NOT part of the pneumatic system: a BOOM LTS/COCKPIT LTS switch (690-lts-boom, cross-ref only, no drawn load circuit here) and a FWD Remote Receiver #1 that duplicates the open/closed/lock/inflate commands for remote control of the same hatch (still 575-pneumatic-system). The sheet is fed from SALOON COMPANION WAY via breaker Q25 6A (companion/upstream device, cross-ref to Q25 supply) and ultimately from +24V Service Battery via fuse F6 160A shown at bottom-left as the ship's DC supply infrastructure entering this branch.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Sheet titled AFT COMPANION WAY maps directly per engineer-confirmed mapping to 575-pneumatic-system; all hatch open/closed valves, pressure switch, inflate/deflate valves and their control switches (local SW19, locker SW/, and FWD Remote Receiver #1 duplicate command set) serve this one pneumatic hatch-seal function.

functions.label: Hatch open/closed pneumatic actuation
functions.what_it_does: Two pneumatic valves (S1 = HATCH OPEN, S2 = HATCH CLOSED) actuate the hatch seal/lid via commands routed through the J/BOX relay bank (Re1-Re5) and terminal strip; commanded locally from SW19 (open/closed/LOCK pushbutton cluster) or remotely from FWD Remote Receiver #1 (which duplicates open/LOCK/closed/BOOM LIGHT commands over the same terminals).
key_components: FWD Remote Receiver #1 (remote duplicate command source)

flow_scenarios.path: Terminal strip (6-16) idle; hatch remains in last commanded position; no relay energised.

SW19 'open' contact (or FWD Remote Receiver #1 pin 1 'open') -> J/BOX terminal(s) 6/7 loop -> relay bank (Re1/Re3 path) -> S1 valve (HATCH OPEN) actuates; the load side of these relays is drawn NO (energised = closed = hatch-open command passes) per netlist Re1_contact/Re3 contact=NO.
SW19 'closed' contact (or FWD Remote Receiver #1 pin 3 'closed') -> terminal loop (8/9/10) -> relay bank (Re4/Re5 path, contact=NO) -> S2 valve (HATCH CLOSED) actuates.

SW19 'LOCK' contact (or FWD Remote Receiver #1 pin 2 'LOCK') -> terminal loop (11-16, three 2.7K-tapped monitoring lines 12/13/14/16) -> relay bank -> holds hatch in locked state; 2.7K resistors on these lines indicate they are monitored/supervised (status) circuits rather than raw power feeds.

functions.dry_data: J/BOX terminal strip terminals 2-16; relays Re1-Re5; local pushbutton SW19 (open/closed/lock); remote duplicate via FWD Remote Receiver #1 pins 1-3; +24V DC control voltage (vessel standard).
functions.sheet_region: top-left J/BOX enclosure (Re1-Re5, terminals 2-16) and top-right hatch valve/SW19 cluster, bbox ~[0.17,0.09]-[0.9,0.37]

functions.label: Hatch seal inflate/deflate control and pressure sensing
functions.what_it_does: Controls the pneumatic seal bladder inflate/deflate valves (V1 main valve and an AUX valve) via relays Re6-Re8, monitored by a digital pressure switch (opens when inflated) and a reed switch giving a CLOSED SIGNAL status. Commanded from an inside-locker SW/ pushbutton or remotely.

flow_scenarios.path: Bladder deflated; digital pressure switch contact closed (per label 'open when inflated', meaning it is normally closed until pressure builds); reed switch open (hatch not confirmed closed).

SW/ (inside locker, terminals 1/2) -> Re6/Re7 relay coils energised -> terminal 21/22 -> V1 valve opens -> seal inflates; when fully inflated the digital pressure switch opens (protective de-energise/interlock signal back to control loop, per its label).

Re8 relay path -> terminal 23 -> AUX INFLATE/DEFLATE valve actuates deflate function; terminal 24 reed switch reports CLOSED SIGNAL status back to monitoring; terminal 25 grounded to chassis earth as the circuit reference/return.

functions.dry_data: V1 + AUX pneumatic solenoid valves; digital pressure switch (setpoint not read on this sheet); reed switch closed-signal status contact; relays Re6-Re8; terminals 21-25.
functions.sheet_region: middle band (digital pressure switch ~[0.66,0.17]-[0.77,0.22]) and bottom band (Re6-Re8, V1/AUX valve, reed switch, terminals 21-25 ~[0.2,0.79]-[0.78,0.87])

infrastructure.system_name: AFT Companion Way J/BOX distribution & terminal strip
facts: J/BOX enclosure (dotted rectangle) houses relay bank Re1-Re5, main terminal strip (terminals 2-25), fed from SALOON COMPANION WAY via breaker Q25 6A.
Terminal 19 is a fused terminal (built-in replaceable fuse, drawn as inner rectangle crossed by line) — a known troubleshooting point for the +24V SUPPLY line to FWD Remote Receiver #1 pin 6.
Terminals 12, 13, 14, 16 carry 2.7K resistor taps — these are supervised/monitored status lines (open-loop detection), not raw power feeds.
Terminals 1-5 group at left connects to J/BOX terminal-out block 'to PEDESTAL J/BOX 3 (see DWG 124d)' — cross-sheet continuation.
Sheet bottom-left shows +24V SERVICE BAT. feeding via fuse F6 160A up to breaker Q25 6A — this is vessel DC supply infrastructure, not part of the pneumatic system itself.

BOOM LTS/COCKPIT LTS switch (labelled C22) appears on this sheet only as a switch block with no drawn load-circuit lines to any device on this sheet — its full lighting circuit is not on this drawing and is cross-referenced only.
